name: kylo-3d-shorts
description: Make viral vertical 3D Shorts in real Blender with Claude: 'How a hole becomes a bunker' cutaway builds with little people, or realistic 'What happens if you...' explainers with X-ray anatomy; ElevenLabs narration, sound effects and music, captions — script to upload-ready mp4.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Optional. For narration, sound effects and music (elevenlabs.io → Settings → API keys; enable Text to Speech, Sound Effects, Music Generation). Leave empty if you record the voice yourself.
